# sq-59 — Note required-member compiler support for library consumers

`required` members need C# 11 (CS8936 at LangVersion 10); consumers on an older C# or on VB.NET cannot `new` ProfileOptions or FieldProfile (the compiler marks the constructor obsolete), though they can read members and use `ProfileOptions.Create`. The target is net10.0, so risk is low. Add one sentence to the user guide's library section.
